# Vendored from esp32-agent-companion

`sprite-motion.js` is taken unmodified from
https://github.com/DanWahlin/esp32-agent-companion (`web/sprite-motion.js`),
with `sprite-motion.test.cjs` from that repository's `tests/` alongside it so
the vendored copy stays verified.

Copyright belongs to Dan Wahlin. That repository carries no LICENSE file at the
time of vendoring, so redistribution is pending his permission - see the
licensing note in the root README. Nothing in this directory is modified; if it
needs to change, change it upstream or replace it, so the provenance stays
clean.
